title: viburnum lantana f. variegatum
intro: Viburnum lantana f. variegatum, commonly known as the Variegated Wayfaring Tree, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Viburnum lantana f. variegatum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and antispasmodic agent, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
